units: <cite ref="Chullin 64a:6">Ḥull. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ראשה אחד חד</he> if one side of the egg is pointed, the other rounded (<cite ref="K00098"><he>כַּד</he></cite>); <cite ref="Chullin 64a:6">ib.</cite> (Chald.) <he>רישיה חד חד</he>.—Pl. <he>חַדִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:31">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ חרב ח׳ וכ׳</he> even if a sharpened sword is laid on one’s throat, one must not despair of praying for divine mercy.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:4">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> (play on <he>ח̇ד̇ק̇ל̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:14">Gen. II, 14</cite>) <he>שהיתה ק̇ל̇ה וח̇ד̇ה וכ׳</he> (Greece) who was rash and sharp in her decrees.
<cite ref="Berakhot 59b:12">Ber. 59ᵇ</cite> (play on <cite ref="H00211"><he>חדקל</he></cite>) its waters <he>ח׳ וקלין</he> are swift and light.—V. <cite ref="H00177"><he>חַדָּה</he></cite>.
